entities.summary: Josef Vlastimil Burian, better known as Vlasta Burian, was a Czech actor, singer, comedian, footballer and film director. He is among the most famous Czech actors and comedians of the first half of the 20th century. In the Czech Republic, he is nicknamed "King of Comedians".
